blocks.h2: What a Maintenance Visit Can (and Can't) Fix
blocks.intro: A maintenance visit is built around prevention, not repair. Here's where the line falls:
head: Included in a Maintenance Visit
Needs a Different Service
rows: A camera inspection to check your line's current condition
An active sewage backup. Likely fix: [Emergency Plumbing](/hanover-park/emergency-plumbing)
Catching early root growth or wear before it becomes a bigger problem
A cracked or collapsed pipe. Likely fix: [Sewer Repair](/hanover-park/sewer-repair)
A light interior clean as part of the visit
A heavy clog that needs full clearing. Likely fix: [Sewer Rodding](/hanover-park/sewer-rodding) or [Hydro Jetting](/hanover-park/hydro-jetting)
An honest assessment of what your line needs next
A line at the end of its lifespan. Likely fix: [Trenchless Sewer Repair](/hanover-park/trenchless-sewer-repair)
blocks.note: If your line needs more than a checkup, we'll tell you exactly what and why. No surprise upsells.

img.alt: J. Blanton plumber in shoe covers on a home's front steps with a sewer camera

blocks.h2: Maintenance Costs Less Than a Backup
blocks.body: A scheduled cleaning is short, planned and done when it suits you. A backup is the opposite: it happens on a holiday weekend, it soaks carpet and drywall in a finished basement and it often comes with a cleanup bill on top of the plumbing. For Hanover Park homes with a known root problem or a low spot, a yearly visit costs far less than one bad day. If your line has never given you trouble, a camera check every few years is plenty.

blocks.h2: Sewer Maintenance Questions From Hanover Park Homeowners

items.q: How often should I service my sewer line?
items.preview: Yearly if roots are a problem.
items.answer: If you've had root clogs, yearly. If not, a camera check every few years.

items.q: What's the best time of year?
items.answer: Late winter or early spring, before roots grow and storms arrive.

items.preview: No, but it keeps it clear.
items.answer: No. Cleaning keeps waste from building up there. Fixing it means resetting that section.

items.q: Is maintenance part of the No Drip Club?
items.preview: The club includes regular maintenance visits.
items.answer: The [No Drip Club](/no-drip-club) includes regular maintenance visits for homeowners.

items.q: Will you remind me when it's time?
items.answer: Yes. We can set a reminder for your next visit.

items.q: What if my line is fine?
items.answer: Then we'll tell you, and we won't sell you a schedule you don't need.

items.preview: It depends on the service. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on whether the line needs rodding, jetting or a camera check. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
